IGUI_MilitaryDrop_RequestTooltip: Call the military on this radio to request a supply drop.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_TurnOn: The radio must be turned on.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NotCarried: Hold the radio in your hands or wear it on your back.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_CannotCall: I can't call anyone with this radio.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Busy: Too fast. Let the radio settle a moment.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoSite: Negative, no safe drop zone near your position. Try again from another spot. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Cooldown: I can't reach them right now. I should try again in %1 hours.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Call_1: This is the quarantine zone, we need an emergency arms drop. Can you send a package?
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Call_2: Alert! We are out of arms. Requesting immediate drop of ammunition and weapons!
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Call_3: Military base, this is the Knox survivors. We need an arms drop, the situation is critical.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Call_4: Requesting urgent resupply of arms. Our stocks are depleted and we need support. Can you help us?
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Call_5: Hello, this is the disaster area. We need weapons and ammunition urgently. Can you perform an arms drop?
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Ack_1: Received. Arms drop in progress. Hold on, reinforcements are on the way.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Ack_2: Message received. We are proceeding with the drop of ammunition and weapons. Good luck.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Ack_3: Your request is confirmed. The arms package will be dropped in your area shortly.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Ack_4: Well received. Prepare to receive the arms drop. Stay vigilant.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Ack_5: Affirmative. We are sending an arms drop immediately. Watch the sky.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_BroadcastInbound: All stations, Logistics. Supply helicopter en route to a requested drop zone, ETA one minute.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_BroadcastDropped: Supply crate delivered at grid %1 / %2. I repeat, grid %1 / %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_1: Emergency frequency: %1 MHz. Need backup and airdrop of light weapons and ammunition. Authentication code: %2. Position: grid 07Z.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_2: Secure channel: %1 MHz. Requesting immediate airdrop of handguns and assault rifles. Authentication code: %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_3: Message to armed forces: the frequency %1 MHz is now dedicated to airdrop requests. Give code %2 to be authenticated.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_4: Attention: the frequency 105.5 MHz is temporarily unavailable for airdrop requests. Use the backup frequency %1 MHz instead, code %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_5: Alert: hordes of zombies have been spotted in the exclusion zone. Use the frequency %1 MHz to organize an airdrop of weapons and ammunition in bulk. Code: %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_6: Mission order: the frequency %1 MHz is to be used for airdrop requests of silenced weapons and associated ammunition. Authentication: %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_7: Message to airdrop pilots: the frequency %1 MHz is to be used for airdrop requests of long-range weapons and scopes. Priority to snipers. Code %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Note_8: Reminder to radio operators: supply drops are only authorized on %1 MHz with today's authentication code, %2. Do not broadcast this code.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteOpen_1: Emergency frequency: %1 MHz. Supply drops can be requested on this channel. No authentication until further notice.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteOpen_2: To all units: airdrop requests are handled on %1 MHz. Keep the channel clear for emergencies.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteOpen_3: Logistics reminder: request resupply on %1 MHz. The helicopter drops far from the caller; the grid is announced on the same frequency.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteOpen_4: Secure channel %1 MHz reopened for drop requests. Authentication suspended by order of command.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteWeek_1: Drop requests on %1 MHz. Authentication code for this week: %2, valid through %3. Codes change every Monday at 00:00.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteWeek_2: Radio operators: this week's code is %2, until %3 at midnight. Frequency %1 MHz. Do not broadcast this code.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteWeek_3: Supply requests: call %1 MHz and give code %2. It expires after %3.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteWeek_4: Mission order: resupply on %1 MHz. Weekly authentication %2, valid through %3. The old code is still accepted for 24 hours after the change.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteCipher_1: Drop requests on %1 MHz. This week's authentication code is sent by the numbers station on %2 MHz. Decode it with the current codebook.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteCipher_2: To radio operators: listen to %2 MHz for the weekly code groups, codebook required. Then call %1 MHz to request a drop.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteCipher_3: Codes now change every Monday at 00:00. Numbers station: %2 MHz. Drop requests: %1 MHz. Report any lost codebook.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoteCipher_4: Secure channel %1 MHz. Authentication: weekly code sent on %2 MHz, the first two groups encrypted, the last two digits in clear.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Numbers_End: End of message. End of message.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Doc_Codebook_Instructi: The authentication code changes every Monday at 00:00; the previous code stays valid for 24 hours. The numbers station sends three groups, for example 17-04-58: find the first two groups below to get the two words. The last two digits are sent in clear.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Doc_Codebook_Footer: CONFIDENTIAL - NEVER BROADCAST A DECODED CODE
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LineCut: %1, Logistics. Your station's authorization is suspended. Do not call this frequency until further notice. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier1_1: %1, Logistics. Request approved, reluctantly. Your record is poor. Recover this drop. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier1_2: %1, Logistics. Approved, but your credit is running out. Account for every crate. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier1_3: %1, Logistics. Drop authorized under review. Your unit's record is under scrutiny. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier2_1: %1, Logistics. Request approved. Your record needs work. Do not waste this drop. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier2_2: %1, Logistics. Copy. Drop authorized. We expect those crates recovered. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier2_3: %1, Logistics. Approved. Prove your station deserves the next one. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier3_1: %1, Logistics. Request approved. Supply drop inbound. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier3_2: %1, Logistics. Copy your request. Drop authorized, watch the sky. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier3_3: %1, Logistics. Affirmative. Supplies are on the way. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier4_1: %1, Logistics. Your unit's record is excellent. Priority drop inbound. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier4_2: %1, Logistics. Good to hear you. Drop approved at once. Keep up the good work. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_AckTier4_3: %1, Logistics. Trusted station, request granted. Supplies inbound, priority one. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Exchange_ReportTooltip: Once a day, the base expects a situation report from each station.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Exchange_DogTagsToolti: Read to the base the names on the dog tags of fallen soldiers you carry (not your own). Each name counts once; an announced tag is set aside.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Exchange_ReconTooltip: When the base orders a recon, confirm it from the announced grid.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Exchange_ControlToolti: Answer the base's radio check while it lasts.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NotInInventory: The radio must be in your inventory.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_NoDogTags: I have no fallen soldier's dog tags to announce.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_SourceDisabled: The base does not handle this on this server.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Report_1: Logistics, situation report: position holding, nothing unusual. Over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Report_2: Logistics, daily report: we are still alive and the sector is quiet. Over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Report_3: Logistics, situation report: infected activity as usual, no losses. Over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_DogTags_1: Logistics, I have %1 dog tags from fallen soldiers. Reading the names now.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_DogTags_2: Logistics, recovered %1 dog tags from fallen soldiers. Stand by to copy the names.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Recon_1: Logistics, I'm at the recon grid. Zone status follows.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Recon_2: Logistics, on site at the requested grid. Reporting zone status.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Say_Control_1: Logistics, reading you loud and clear. Over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_Recon: All stations, Logistics. Recon required at grid %1 / %2. First station to confirm on site within %3 hours. I repeat, grid %1 / %2.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_Cleanup: All stations, Logistics. Large infected concentration around grid %1 / %2, radius %3 tiles. First station to neutralize %4 hostiles in the zone within %5 hours.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_Control: All stations, Logistics. Radio check. Confirm reception on this frequency within %1 hours.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_ReconDone: All stations, recon of grid %1 / %2 confirmed by %3. Order closed.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_ReconExpired: All stations, recon order for grid %1 / %2 cancelled.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_CleanupDone: All stations, zone around grid %1 / %2 cleared by %3. Order closed.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_CleanupExpir: All stations, clearance order for grid %1 / %2 cancelled.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Broadcast_ControlClose: All stations, radio check closed. Stations that answered: %1.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_Report_2: %1, copy your report. Keep your heads down. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_Report_3: %1, report logged. Call again tomorrow. Out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_ReportAlready: %1, we already have your report for today. Call again tomorrow.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_DogTags: %1, logged: %2. Thank you, the families will be informed.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_DogTagsKnown: %1, already logged: %2. Nothing more to report on those tags.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_DogTagsCap: %1, that is enough for today. Keep the other tags and call again tomorrow.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_NoRecon: %1, negative, no recon order is open.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_ReconFar: %1, you are not at the grid. Recon point: %2 / %3.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_Disabled: %1, negative, we do not handle that on this channel.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostInstallTooltip: Makes this radio your station's liaison post: transmission log, current missions and the team's dog tags to announce. One post per station; installing another one moves it here.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostTransmitSay: Logistics, this is %1. Announcing fallen soldiers' dog tags, over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostTrust4: Command holds you in high regard
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_moved: Liaison post moved to this radio.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_already: This radio is already our liaison post.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_otherTeam: Another station runs its liaison post on this radio.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_notEligible: This radio can't serve as a liaison post.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_notPost: This radio isn't our liaison post anymore.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_tooFar: I need to get closer to the radio.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_noTags: I have no tags to deposit.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_radioOff: The radio has to be on and powered.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_unavailable: Command isn't taking dog tags right now.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_held: Command won't take more for now: %1 tag(s) stay at the post.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_DismantleTooltip: Take the empty crate apart for its wood, like wooden furniture.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_Reply_DogTagsFull: %1, your record is already excellent. Keep the other tags for later.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostResult_lineCut: Command has cut the line: no announcements for now.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostEffectLineCut: Drops: none while the line is cut.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_PostStandingTooltip: Command's trust rises with crates recovered by your station, daily reports, announced dog tags and missions. It falls when your crates are lost or taken by others, and with repeated wrong codes.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_SirenStopTooltip: Open the beacon casing and disconnect the siren.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_SirenCannotStop: You can't reach the siren from here.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_water: Bottles and canteens, filled with clean water.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_tools: Hand tools for building and repairs.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_camping: Camping gear, fire starters, fishing and trapping.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_firearms: One firearm, two magazines and a box of rounds.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_attachments: Sights, lights and other weapon parts.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_LotDesc_fuel: One fuel can, full of gasoline.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_OrderInvalid: Negative, your requisition does not match your clearance. Resubmit.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_OrderExpired: Negative, your authorization has expired. Call again.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqFormSay: %1, this is Logistics. Send your requisition, over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqOrderSay: Logistics, this is %1. Requisition follows, over.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqCancelSay: Logistics, this is %1. Disregard my requisition, out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqExpired: This is Logistics. Your authorization has expired. Call again, out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqOrderInvalid: This is Logistics. Requisition not in order, nothing leaves. Call again, out.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqDecoyDesc: A dummy crate dropped in the chosen sector. Its siren draws the infected away from you. Cannot be combined with other items.
IGUI_MilitaryDrop_ReqNoSector: This is Logistics. No drop point in that sector. Pick another sector, over.
